plugins.name: app-documentation
plugins.description: Document how an application works — a grounded technical reference doc per part of the system, then end-user and operator guides derived from them and verified against the real UI. Audits existing docs for drift.

plugins.name: modular-monolith
plugins.description: The modular-monolith blueprint as an installable plugin — audit a repo against it, adopt or decline each area, and record the decisions in docs/ROADMAP.md so agents enforce exactly what was chosen.

plugins.name: regression-runbooks
plugins.description: Exhaustively explore any web-app area and write tiered regression runbooks (manual + automated), self-improving after every run.

plugins.name: smoke-tests
plugins.description: Write short, plain-language smoke tests a human runs by hand — for one change, or for everything since the last release so a tester can target only what changed.
